arxiv-2111-14762.title: Probabilistic Riemannian Functional Map Synchronization for 3D Shape Correspondence
arxiv-2111-14762.creator: Faria Huq, Adrish Dey, Sahra Yusuf, Dena Bazazian, Tolga Birdal, Nina Miolane
arxiv-2111-14762.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Faria Huq, Adrish Dey, Sahra Yusuf, Dena Bazazian, Tolga Birdal, Nina Miolane. We consider the problem of graph-matching on a network of 3D shapes with uncertainty quantification. We assume that the pairwise shape correspondences are efficiently represented as functional maps , that match real-valued functions defined over pairs of shapes.

arxiv-2201-12799.title: Recognition of Implicit Geographic Movement in Text
arxiv-2201-12799.description: Abstract Analyzing the geographic movement of humans, animals, and other phenomena is a growing field of research. This research has benefited urban planning, logistics, animal migration understanding, and much more. Typically, the movement is captured as precise geographic coordinates and time stamps with Global Positioning Systems (GPS).

arxiv-2308-11642.title: Gesture Recognition based on Long-Short Term Memory Cells (LSTM) using Smartphone IMUs Conference: Fachpraktikum Interaktive Systeme; Summer 2018; University of Stuttgart, Germany Price: 00.00
arxiv-2308-11642.creator: Yuvaraj Govindarajulu, Raja Rajeshwari Raj Kumar
arxiv-2308-11642.description: Abstract . Over the last few decades, Smartphone technology has seen significant improvements. Enhancements specific to built-in Inertial Measurement Units (IMUs) and other dedicated sensors of the smartphones(which are often available as default) such as- Accelerometer, Gyroscope, Magnetometer, Fingerprint reader, Proximity and Ambient light sensors have made devices smarter and the interaction seamless.

arxiv-2312-12035.title: Embeddable partial Hadamard matrices related to the projective planes
arxiv-2312-12035.creator: Hadi Kharaghani, Sho Suda, Yash Shamsundar Khobragade
arxiv-2312-12035.description: Abstract The existence of a projective plane of order p ≡ 3 ( mod 4 ) p\equiv 3\pmod{4} , where p p is a prime power, is shown to be equivalent to the existence of a balancedly multi-splittable embeddable p 2 × p ⁡ ( p + 1 ) p^{2}\times p(p+1) partial Hadamard matrix.

arxiv-2403-19552.title: Probing the dark Universe with gravitational waves
arxiv-2403-19552.creator: Antonio Enea Romano
arxiv-2403-19552.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Antonio Enea Romano. Gravitational waves (GW) are expected to interact with dark energy and dark matter, affecting their propagation on cosmological scales. In order to model this interaction, we derive a gauge invariant effective equation and action valid for all GWs polarizations, based on encoding the effects of the interaction of GWs at different orders in perturbations, in a polarization, frequency and time dependent effective speed.

arxiv-2407-21528.title: Infinitesimal behavior of Quadratically Regularized Optimal Transport and its relation with the Porous Medium Equation
arxiv-2407-21528.creator: Alejandro Garriz-Molina, Alberto González-Sanz, Gilles Mordant
arxiv-2407-21528.description: Abstract The quadratically regularized optimal transport problem has recently been considered in various applications where the coupling needs to be sparse , i.e., the density of the coupling needs to be zero for a large subset of the product of the supports of the marginals.

arxiv-2411-08942.title: Experimental and theoretical evidence of universality in superfluid vortex reconnections
arxiv-2411-08942.creator: P. Z. Stasiak, Y. Xing, Y. Alihosseini, C.F. Barenghi, A. Baggaley, W. Guo, L. Galantucci, G. Krstulovic
arxiv-2411-08942.description: Abstract The minimum separation between reconnecting vortices in fluids and superfluids obeys a universal scaling law with respect to time. The pre-reconnection and the post-reconnection prefactors of this scaling law are different, a property related to irreversibility and to energy transfer and dissipation mechanisms.

arxiv-2506-04886.title: Gaussian Process Diffeomorphic Statistical Shape Modelling Out Performs Angle Based Methods for Assessment of Hip Dysplasia
arxiv-2506-04886.creator: Allen Paul, George Grammatopoulos, Adwaye Rambojun, Neill D. F. Campbell, Harinderjit S. Gill, Tony Shardlow
arxiv-2506-04886.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Allen Paul, George Grammatopoulos, Adwaye Rambojun, Neill D. F. Campbell, Harinderjit S. Gill, Tony Shardlow. Dysplasia is a recognised risk factor for osteoarthritis (OA) of the hip, early diagnosis of dysplasia is important to provide opportunities for surgical interventions aimed at reducing the risk of hip OA.

arxiv-2508-03492.creator: 1 st Mohammadsadegh Khoshghiaferezaee, 2 nd Moritz Krauth, 3 rd Shima Shabani, 4 th Michael Breuß
arxiv-2508-03492.description: Abstract Sparse dictionary learning (SDL) is a fundamental technique that is useful for many image processing tasks. As an example we consider here image recovery, where SDL can be cast as a nonsmooth optimization problem. For this kind of problems, iterative shrinkage methods represent a powerful class of algorithms that are subject of ongoing research.

Kehlleisten), a term given in architecture to a moulding of a double curvature, convex and concave, in which the former is the uppermost (see Moulding Mouldings). The name “ogee-arch” is often applied to an arch formed by the meeting of two contrasted ogees (see Arch).

pmc-11328869.title: Strategies for Targeting Peptide-Modified Exosomes and Their Applications in the Lungs
pmc-11328869.creator: Min Qiu, Jinru Zou, Zheng Yang, Dan Yang, Rui Wang, Haie Guo
pmc-11328869.description: Exosomes belong to a subgroup of extracellular vesicles secreted by various cells and are involved in intercellular communication and material transfer. In recent years, exosomes have been used as drug delivery carriers because of their natural origin, high stability, low immunogenicity and high engineering ability. However, achieving targeted drug delivery with exosomes remains challenging.

pmc-11334802.title: Photobioreactors for building integration: A overview of designs and architectural potential
pmc-11334802.creator: Ruma Arora, K. Sudhakar, R.S. Rana
pmc-11334802.description: The global community faces critical energy and environmental challenges, necessitating innovative solutions to ensure a sustainable future.In response to these challenges, this paper explores the potential of integrating microalgal biotechnology with renewable energy systems within buildings. This innovative approach could transform architecture into a "bio-factory" capable of producing food, energy, and other valuable products.

pmc-12553220.title: Prognostic importance of CD47 expression on survival of colorectal cancer
pmc-12553220.creator: Oktay Halit Aktepe, Olcay Kurtulan, Pinar Ezgi Dama, Eda Caliskan Yildirim, Aytac Terzi, Simin Alara Kalyoncu, Elif Atag, Tugba Yavuzsen, Meral Uner, Aziz Karaoglu, Suayib Yalcin
pmc-12553220.description: BackgroundThe exact value of cluster of differentiation 47 (CD47), known as the “don’t eat me” signal, in colorectal cancer (CRC) has not been clearly revealed. Thus, we investigated the impact of its expression on the overall survival (OS) of CRC patients who underwent colectomy.MethodsNinety-eight CRC patients were included.

pmc-12590838.title: Time-to-death and its predictors among under five children in the developing regions of ethiopia: a cross sectional study
pmc-12590838.creator: Gebru Gebremeskel Gebrerufael, Brhane Gebrehiwot Welegebrial, Mehari Gebre Teklezgi, Zeytu Gashaw Asfaw, Yemane Hailu Fissuh, Gebregewergis Alemu Gebremedhn
pmc-12590838.description: BackgroundThe under-five children mortality rate (U5CM) is still a global public health concern, especially in Ethiopia and other countries in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). Unfortunately, the issue is notably underestimated and underreported, making it difficult to fully assess the severity of the crisis in the nation-state’s emerging regions.

pmc-12781373.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background/objectivesSyphilis remains a growing public health concern, with increasing reported incidence globally. pmc-13224187.title: An intra-axial wolf in extra-axial clothing: A rare case of high-grade astrocytoma and literature review
pmc-13224187.creator: Talha Sajid, Muhammad Arslan Iqbal, Khawar Zaman, Salman Ahmed, Umer Farooq Raina
pmc-13224187.description: Background: High-grade astrocytomas are typically intra-axial, diffusely infiltrating brain tumors. Their presentation as a primary dural-based, extra-axial mass mimicking an aggressive meningioma is exceptionally rare, creating a significant diagnostic challenge and potential for preoperative misdiagnosis.Case Description: A 40-year-old male presented with a 2.5-year history of headache and vertigo, followed by generalized seizures.

pmc-13587075.title: Spatial transcriptomics reveals atorvastatin modulates the tumor microenvironment to suppress breast cancer liver metastatic outgrowth
pmc-13587075.creator: Neha Atale, Jie Chen, Brian R. Isett, Riyue Bao, Ernest M Meyer, Alan Wells
pmc-13587075.description: Metastatic breast cancer remains incurable, underscoring the need for novel therapeutic strategies. Epidemiological and preclinical evidence suggests statins suppress metastatic outgrowth, however the underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We employed high-resolution spatial transcriptomics (ST) to explore the cellular composition and differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in the metastatic microenvironment following atorvastatin treatment.

pmc-13619846.title: Human In Vivo Validation of Frequency‐Dependent QTI
pmc-13619846.creator: Svenja Niesen, Marten Veldmann, Ali Ajouz, Tony Stöcker
pmc-13619846.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). PurposeThe aim of this work is to investigate if q‐space trajectory imaging (QTI) waveforms can be designed to probe QTI metrics at a single centroid frequency under realistic experimental conditions for in vivo human brain imaging.MethodsRealistic diffusion encoding waveforms based on double‐rotation gradient waveform and magic‐angle spinning of the q‐vector with varying encoding bandwidth, alignment of encoding spectra across encodings (tuning) and across axes (spectral isotropy) were designed to investigate the accuracy of the centroid frequency approximation.
